The accuracy of landing an <c:ffff00>attack<c> and the ability to
hit the <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c>'s weak point.
It is mostly determined by the <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c> stat of the
<c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c> and the <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c> in <c:ffff00>Striking<c>/<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>;
the <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> stat of the <c:ffff00>legs<c> also has an
effect.
The higher the {{success_power}}, the higher the
<c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c> rate. The chances of <c:ffff00>{{attack_failure}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{graze}}<c> and
the target's <c:ffff00>evasion power<c> also go down.
